name: checksum_truncated

name: fcs_max_u64
command: python3: pyzstd.compress(b'hello world', 3) with the descriptor rewritten to Frame_Content_Size_flag=3 declaring 18446744073709551615
why: a 27-byte frame asking for a size no allocator will give; pyzstd refuses it: ZstdError

name: fcs_2p40
